rationale: No spec was supplied, so acceptance did not run and confidence is low. The one blocker is the commit-format standard: all 5 commit subjects use the ticket-ID form instead of the documented '<type>: <description>', and the guide or the commits need to change. The 6 edge-case candidates were checked against source; 5 were dismissed as unreachable or below the emission floor, and the auth 'unknown' one is by design. Nothing deferred. A failed deferred-file write is not applicable.

findings.title: Commit subjects violate documented format
findings.problem: git-workflow.md documents '<type>: <short description>' with type in feat|fix|docs|test|chore|refactor, but every commit in the range (d5a5668..HEAD) uses 'EPMCDME-14658 : <subject>' with no conventional type.
findings.impact: commit-format is a documented blocking standard and every commit in the range deviates from it.
findings.recommendation: Reword the subjects to the documented format (e.g. 'feat: wire the broken profile panel'), or update .ai-run/guides/standards/git-workflow.md to document the ticket-ID format if that is the intended convention.
